about: Every file in this repository whose text or configuration changes what a model reads or which model runs. A pull request that changes a file matched here carries evals/<surface>/receipt.json (changed in the same pull request) or a reasoned no-eval line in its body. ops/check-eval-receipt.py enforces it; evals/README.md is the procedure.

surfaces.description: Jev question families, typed-judgment prompts and the TypeSafe client that carries them.
Rule text carried in the repository and the routing that decides which rules reach a session and when.

Hooks that inject text into a session (additionalContext, systemMessage, SessionStart stdout) and the configuration that wires them. ops/check-eval-receipt.py fails when a hook that emits context is not matched here.
Instruction files and skills a session loads as standing guidance.
Builder and reviewer brief templates, review-contract prompts and grader rubrics kept in the repository.
Which model and which effort level a piece of work runs on.

unsure.path: store: rule text and doctrine sections
unsure.why: Most rule text lives in the CARR Record Layer and changes through verbs (amend-rule, write-doctrine-section), not pull requests. This gate cannot see those edits. Registered here only as the repository mirror; a store-side receipt needs its own verb.
A snapshot of home-directory skills. Not registered because it reads as an archive copy rather than something a session loads from this path; register it if anything installs from here.
Serves doctrine and standing-context text to sessions, but is mostly transport and authorization. Rule-selection parts are covered by rule-delivery; left out to avoid gating every server change.

unsure.path: hooks/*.py that only deny with a reason
unsure.why: A deny reason is text the model reads. Only hooks that emit additionalContext, systemMessage or hookSpecificOutput are registered; plain exit-2 stderr reasons are not.
Test and fixture files steer nothing at runtime and are excluded, but they are where an eval's cases live. Changing them changes what a receipt measured; the receipt, not this gate, has to say so.
Build briefs whose text a model later reads. Unclear whether the wording is a steering template or data assembly; not registered pending a look by the owner.
Invoke models with model and effort flags. Registered through model-routing only where the pin lives; the call sites are transport.
